about.title: About Me
about.text: Master's Degree in Cyber Security from the University of Milan and Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science from the University of Parma. Currently serving as PMO & Technology Security at Zefiro NET, managing strategic projects and compliance (NIS2, ISO 27001, GDPR). I combine a deep passion for cybersecurity with experience in IT Project Management and university teaching.
